Grow Expi293F cells (ThermoFisher, A14527) in Expi293™ Expression Medium (ThermoFisher, A1435101) to 2-3 million cells/mL at the desired culture volume, such as 100 mL. Choose the appropriate flask for the desired volume of cell culture to ensure appropriate gas exchange. If cells are grown slightly above 3 million cells/mL (up to 6 million cells/mL), dilute to 3 million cells/mL using fresh medium day-of. Otherwise, dilute below 1.5 million cells/mL and try again another day. Put cells back in the incubator once prepared, for now. Note that these cells require an orbital shaker to keep them in solution. Cells should be >95 % viable (e.g. with trypan blue, Thermofisher 15250061) and doubling every 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA-PEI complex in Opti-MEM medium.

substeps.instruction: Warm Opti-MEM to room temperature (RT).
Transfer 100 mL of RT Opti-MEM per 1L of cells into a small sterile, autoclaved flask (or falcon tubes for smaller volumes).
Transfer endotoxin-free DNA encoding pCMV 3xFLAG-ATG2A into the Opti-MEM and swirl to mix.
Add polyethylenimine (PEI): use either 300 µL per 100 mL cells at 1 mg/mL or 1.5 mL per 1L cells at 2 mg/mL.
Swirl to mix and incubate in the hood for 30-45 minutes.

steps.title: Transfect Expi293 Cells
steps.instruction: Introduce the transfection mixture to the cell culture.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pour the Opti-MEM-DNA-PEI mixture into the flask containing cells while gently shaking.
Return the flask to the incubator and incubate for 18 hours.

steps.title: Boost Protein Production
steps.instruction: Add valproic acid to the transfected cells to increase yield.

substeps.instruction: Add sterile-filtered valproic acid (VPA, 500 mM, Sigma P4543) at 700 µL per 100 mL of cells.
Return to the shaker for 48-72 hours.
Centrifuge cells at 2000 rpm for 20 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant.
Store the resulting pellet at -80 °C if not purifying immediately.

steps.title: Lyse and Clarify Cells
steps.instruction: Break open the cells and remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellets in 10 mL of pre-chilled purification buffer A (500 mM NaCl, 20 mM HEPES pH 8.0, 10% glycerol, 1 mM TCEP) supplemented with 1x EDTA-free protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche 11873580001) per 100 mL of cells.
Lyse cells by subjecting resuspensions to 6 freeze/thaw cycles in liquid nitrogen.
Clarify lysates by centrifugation at 18,500 x G for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Affinity Columns
steps.instruction: Ready the anti-Flag M2 agarose resin.

substeps.instruction: Wash 150 μL of anti-Flag M2 agarose resin per 100 mL of cells with buffer A.

steps.title: Bind Protein to Resin
steps.instruction: Incubate the clarified lysate with the affinity resin.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatants to the columns and incubate under mild agitation for 2 hours at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash and Remove Chaperones
steps.instruction: Clean the resin and remove contaminating chaperones.

substeps.instruction: Pass the lysate through the gravity filtration column and wash the beads with four column volumes of buffer A.
Incubate beads overnight at 4 °C in buffer A supplemented with 2.5 mM ATP and 5 mM Mg2+.
Wash the columns two more times with buffer A.

steps.title: Elute Protein
steps.instruction: Release the purified protein from the resin.

substeps.instruction: Elute using buffer A supplemented with 50 μL of 1 mg/mL 3x-Flag (DYKDDDDK) peptide (ApexBio Technology A6001) per 100 mL of initial culture volume.

steps.title: Quantify and Store Protein
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration and archive samples.

substeps.instruction: Determine protein concentration against a BSA standard curve using Coomassie staining.
Flash freeze protein samples in liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C.
